answer_1.quote: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) has recently gained significant attention as a challenging yet promising task for evaluating systems' capabilities to deeply understand both visual and textual information in order to answer multimodal queries.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to multimodal questions conditioned on retrieved entity and passage information.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our approach using the standard metrics used for assessing the ViQuAE benchmark: F1-score and Exact Match metrics.
